name: Loki Dijeh
source:
Younger Prince of the Black Kingdom. He is hot-blooded and violent. Unlike his older brother, who has the ambition to rule the world, he doesn't care as long as his desires are fulfilled

However, if he doesn't control himself, he will crush even his older brother.

[Translated from [url=http://www.moonparrot.com/html/game/soukoku/chara.html]official website[/url]]
